reason: The text explicitly states that the people said they would stone David (וַתֵּ֨צֶר לְדָוִ֜ד מְאֹ֗ד כִּֽי־ אָמְר֤וּ הָעָם֙ לְסָקְל֔וֹ). This antagonism arose because all the people were embittered in their souls, each man concerning his sons and daughters who had been taken captive when the Amalekites attacked Ziklag. The people's distress over their losses caused them to turn hostile toward David, their leader, blaming him for their misfortune.
